visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A bright, white-walled indoor room serves as the backdrop where three young adults—two females and one male—are seated behind a table densely packed with iridescent, silver-foiled packages. The central female wears a white collared shirt, the female on the left has a white Nike t-shirt, and the male on the right wears a grey-blue t-shirt. They wave enthusiastically at the camera. (2) The video transitions into a fast-paced quiz format. On-screen graphics display gender-swapped images of various celebrities within white rectangular frames. The trio reacts with pointing gestures, wide-mouthed smiles, and celebratory hand-clapping as each answer is revealed. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the top and bottom of the frame to denote the question number and correct answers. (3) The scene shifts back to the group in a medium shot. The woman in the center touches her chin thoughtfully while the others look on with slightly exaggerated expressions of concern or contemplation. The pile of silver JELLY brand packages remains prominent in the foreground under bright, even indoor lighting. (4) This phase focuses on the physical interaction with the products. Close-up shots show hands opening a silver JELLY package, revealing a thin white sanitary pad. The pad is unfolded to demonstrate its thinness and texture. Subsequent shots feature a pink-labeled package and a person using a white wipe on their face in front of a mirror, highlighting the application of the product. (5) The final phase returns to the three main characters sitting together. They are smiling broadly and making peace signs with their hands. The video ends with them waving goodbye towards the camera while surrounded by the shiny silver product packaging, maintaining a high-energy and positive visual atmosphere.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-tempo, bright synth-pop track featuring a steady electronic beat. A group of three voices—two female and one male—erupt in a synchronized, high-arousal greeting. The female voices are high-pitched and clear, while the male voice provides an energetic mid-range counterpoint. (2) During the quiz segment, the speech rate accelerates as the speakers shout out names in rapid succession. The audio is punctuated by sharp post-production sound effects, including a 'ding' for correct answers and a quick 'whoosh' during scene transitions. Background laughter and cheering from the participants create a lively, crowded acoustic environment. (3) The music dips slightly in volume as the tone shifts to a more conversational narrative. The speakers discuss menstrual challenges with a mix of humorous exaggeration and serious undertones. A noticeable 'comic drop' sound effect emphasizes a moment of playful despair before the music swells back up with more energy. (4) A clear, professional-grade narration takes over to describe the product features. The speaker's voice is friendly and persuasive, with high articulation clarity. Underneath, the background music maintains a consistent upbeat rhythm. Occasional 'pop' and 'sparkle' sound effects are used to highlight the positive attributes of the JELLY products being described. (5) The recording concludes with the group's voices rising in volume and pitch for a final sign-off. They shout 'Yeah!' and 'Bye!' in unison with high emotional arousal and positive valence. The music reaches a crescendo before a sharp hard cut at the very end of the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Challenge/Game -> Transition -> Product Features -> CTA/Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote JELLY brand sanitary products through an engaging celebrity-guessing game format that appeals to a young audience by using humor and relatable life experiences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, demonstration of product use, and verbal recommendation of the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends high-energy entertainment with product placement. The fast editing and use of trending 'gender-swap' filters on celebrities capture attention before pivoting to a relatable discussion on menstrual products.
